phase_b_summary.verdict: If single-head / coarsened deltas are similar to 8-head macro, multi-head loss is NOT the main reason the deep model stuck at prior. If coarsened >> 8-head, prefer fewer heads.

recommendations.change: 不要重启 R2 / 不要在同一 8-head BCE+同一特征上继续堆 GPU 小时
recommendations.evidence: R2≈0.5966 matches train-prior-on-val macro LL=0.596610 (val self-prior=0.596412); collapse to constant prevalence.
recommendations.next_experiment: 训练日志必须显式打印常数先验基线；若 1–2 个 chunk 后仍落在先验 ±1e-3 内则自动停训。

recommendations.change: 不要把泄漏/错位当作主修方向
recommendations.evidence: temporal_integrity.ok=True, alignment.ok=True; future-corrupt leaves features invariant and changes labels.
recommendations.next_experiment: 把因果合同测试留在 CI；精力转到标签信息量与特征内容，而非管线臆测。

recommendations.change: 八头稀释是次要问题——可减到 2–4 头，但先修信号路径
recommendations.evidence: 8-head independent macro Δ=-0.0196; best coarsened down_005_only Δ=-0.0245 (similar order).
recommendations.next_experiment: 在同样窗口汇总特征上先做连续 mfe10/mae10（或 first-touch）回归，再考虑 Transformer。

recommendations.change: 特征侧：当前 OHLCVA 汇总相对先验仅 Δ≈0.008–0.025
recommendations.evidence: Cheap logistic on summarized windows beats prior on all 8 heads, but effect sizes are small; deep model failed to harvest even that.
recommendations.next_experiment: 加入截面排序/行业相对收益等便宜特征重跑 logistic；若 Δ 仍 <0.02，先改 10D MFE/MAE 标签定义再谈 ModernBERT。
